pattern: SVG bullet chart as a named, described group (role="group" with aria-roledescription "bullet chart") of role="img" measure bars with roving focus (Up/Down between rows); data table fallback (native table: Measure, Value, Target, Range).

roles.role: group with aria-roledescription (localized "bullet chart"), named by the title
img with an aria-label: measure name, formatted value, target, and the named qualitative range
table (native) with caption, column headers, and row headers; wide tables scroll in a focusable region

roles.element: range bands, target ticks, measure labels, axis, tooltip
roles.role: aria-hidden (decorative duplicates of the accessible data)

aria.value: id of the visible (or visually hidden) title
description id (when provided) and the generated summary id
Localized "{label}: {value}", then ", target {target}" when a target is set, then ", {range}" when ranges are set (for example "Revenue: 270, target 250, Good"); missing values read "No value"
0 on exactly one bar (roving); other bars have none
Table open state and the table region id

keyboard.action: Also next / previous row (swapped in RTL).
Ten rows back / forward (clamped to the first / last).
Hides the tooltip without moving focus (WCAG 1.4.13); it returns on the next move.
One tab stop for the plot (the active measure), then the Show data table button and table region.

focus: Roving focus: one measure bar is in the tab sequence and remembers the last visited measure (by id), also across re-renders (resize, update). Toggling the table keeps focus on the table button.
notes: Qualitative ranges use three neutral shades (not palette colors) and are named in each row's accessible label, tooltip, and table (rangeLabels, default "Range 1"..."Range 3"), so meaning never depends on shading.
The measure falls in the first range whose upper end is at or above the value; values above the last range end read as the last range.
The generated summary lists the measure count, every measure's label text, and how many measures with a target are at or above it (for example "1 of 2 at or above target.").
The target tick is a 3 px text-colored line across the band; the measure bar is a third of the band height.
Forced colors: ranges become Canvas with GrayText outlines, targets and labels CanvasText; focus and hover use Highlight.
No animation: nothing moves on render; hover and focus emphasis transitions are removed under prefers-reduced-motion and animation: none.
knownCaveats: Manual screen-reader verification (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver, TalkBack) is pending.
aria-roledescription support varies; screen readers without it announce "group".
Range band boundaries themselves are not exposed; only the range the value falls in is named.
